Title: Azure Security Center: Public preview updates for April 2021

Body.Content:
In April 2021, the following public preview updates and enhancements were made to Azure Security Center:

  • Refreshed resource health page
  • Use Azure Defender for Kubernetes to protect hybrid and multi-cloud Kubernetes deployments
  • Recommendations to enable Azure Defender for DNS and Resource Manager
  • Four new recommendations related to guest configuration

See the general availability updates for April 2021 here.
